target_profile.scope: Native Apple-silicon macOS binaries, including required public and Apple-specific extensions and ABI behavior; host extensions selected by explicit capability checks.
target_profile.inventory_limits: Reviewed shared A64 forms only. This list is not a complete Apple CPU feature contract, private-extension inventory, or binary-compatibility denominator.

instruction_sources.redistribution_scope: Only factual identifiers, names, categorical/feature metadata and fixed encoding bits are included. Arm XML, authored instruction prose and pseudocode remain local and are not redistributed.

profile.description: Reviewed ordinary control flow and scalar and vector numerical FP under explicit native block exits and serialized runtime dispatch. GuestState* arrives in RDI; the two-u64 BlockExit next_pc/kind returns in RAX/RDX. The nonwrapping, non-streaming profile enables FP/AdvSIMD/FP16/AFP, disables GCS, uses unguarded executable pages and private direct RAM. Numerical S/D common paths execute inline with preserved caller MXCSR; fused S/D uses an exact-product-checked baseline or capability-checked FMA3; vectors evaluate only active lanes, clear the upper half for 64-bit shapes and aggregate sticky status transactionally. Numerical operations without an applicable inline mapping use an immutable-source-validated kind-9 boundary. Retained numerical exception enables decline before active FP effects except AH=1 estimates/refinements, which suppress every fresh exception, and unsigned estimates, which ignore FP controls. False FCCMP/FCCMPE conditions write fallback NZCV without evaluating FP values or numerical controls. Reciprocal estimates use standard precision with FEAT_RPRES absent. SVC/BRK partially support a precise typed kind-5 boundary retaining kind, imm16 and preferred exception return PC; architectural exception entry is pending.
outside_scope: GCS, guarded-page BTI checks and PSTATE.BTYPE
disabled-FP access checks, streaming SME and numerical FP exception delivery
architectural exception delivery and asynchronous state reconstruction
privilege, MMU, devices and full ARM memory ordering
full process ABI, application loading and macOS boot

status_policy: Block and leaf counts are separate profile assessments of canonical forms. Nine forms overlap; counts must not be added. No Apple ISA or compatibility denominator is established.

fused_numerical_fp.review: Both target profiles retain 18,402 raw comparisons each: baseline completes 568 inline, exits to helpers unchanged 17,568 times and refuses 266 controls; checked FMA3 completes 1,822 inline, exits to helpers unchanged 16,314 times and refuses 266 controls. Actual emitted binaries receive 648 feature-containment checks per profile (1,296 total). Each profile completes 357 Rust state comparisons and 43 precise refusal checks. The original full-frame producer and actual runtime completion are distinct evidence.

conversion_numerical_fp.review: x86_64-baseline retains 33,380 raw comparisons: 12,318 completed inline, 19,921 unchanged helper exits and 1,141 precise refusals; it completes 854 Rust state comparisons and 169 refusal checks. x86_64-baseline+ssse3+sse4.1+sse4.2+pclmulqdq+fma retains 33,380 raw comparisons: 12,318 completed inline, 19,921 unchanged helper exits and 1,141 precise refusals; it completes 854 Rust state comparisons and 169 refusal checks. The original full-frame producer, unchanged native boundaries and successful runtime completion remain separate evidence; requested trap enables retain their original-readback limitation.

comparison_minmax_numerical.review: Both target profiles retain 39,724 raw comparisons each: 7,888 direct original inline equalities, 600 separate conditional-false control-policy successes, 29,880 unchanged helper exits and 1,356 precise refusals. Each profile completes 1,089 Rust state comparisons including 103 separately counted policy successes, plus 114 refusal checks. Policy successes do not receive original-equality credit; original full-frame captures, unchanged boundaries and actual runtime completion remain separate evidence.

round_integral_numerical.review: Both target profiles retain 27,281 raw comparisons each: 13,792 direct original inline equalities, 13,160 unchanged helper exits and 329 precise refusals. Each profile completes 769 Rust state comparisons and 53 refusal checks. Actual emitted binaries receive 304 feature-containment checks per profile (608 total); baseline excludes ROUND, checked recipes require SSE4.1, and scalar H retains the integer recipe. Original full-frame captures, unchanged boundaries and successful runtime completion remain separate evidence.

sqrt_numerical.review: Both target profiles retain 11,123 raw comparisons each: 2,768 direct original inline equalities, 8,320 unchanged helper exits and 35 precise refusals. Each profile completes 280 Rust state comparisons and 11 refusal checks. Main native emission has 32 containment checks per profile (64 total); 16 additional probes verify independent F16C availability. F16C is independent of FMA and SSE tiers and requires usable AVX OS state. Original full-frame captures, unchanged native boundaries and successful runtime completion remain separate evidence.

estimate_numerical.review: x86_64-baseline: 27,029 direct original inline equalities, 28 requested-control policy and 302 declared-profile model inline checks, 9,305 unchanged helpers, 70 precise refusals; 358 runtime completions include 52 policy and 24 model checks. x86_64-baseline+ssse3+sse4.1+sse4.2+pclmulqdq+fma+f16c: 27,029 direct original inline equalities, 28 requested-control policy and 302 declared-profile model inline checks, 9,305 unchanged helpers, 70 precise refusals; 358 runtime completions include 52 policy and 24 model checks. Policy/model checks never receive direct original-equality credit. Actual emitted binaries retain separate feature, source/map and preservation proof; original full-frame captures, native boundaries and successful runtime completion remain distinct.

binary_remaining_numerical.review: Both target profiles retain 33,518 raw observations each: 9,096 direct original inline equalities, 23,960 unchanged helper exits and 462 precise refusals. Each profile completes 563 Rust state comparisons and 58 typed refusals. This family has zero requested-control policy or profile-model success classes; all retained enables refuse, including AH=1. Final mapping proof binds 1,272 family artifacts, 9,717 prior-byte/map/extent comparisons and 288 measured block/suffix references. Original full frames, unchanged native boundaries and successful runtime completion remain distinct.

widening_numerical.review: Both target profiles retain 21,256 raw observations each: 6,733 direct original inline equalities, 14,355 unchanged helper exits and 168 precise refusals. Each profile completes 284 Rust state comparisons and 28 typed refusals. This family has zero requested-control policy or profile-model success classes; all retained enables refuse, including AH=1. Final mapping proof binds 3,968 eight-target family artifacts, 32 measured native references and 288 selected block/suffix matches. Prior preservation retains 10,855 directly checked unique compiled tuples covering 10,995 references; the selected closure permits only the new FHM emitter and separately reviewed Python fixture changes, with zero additional old compiles. Original full frames, unchanged native boundaries and successful runtime completion remain distinct.

bfloat16_numerical.review: The two profiles retain 42,004 raw observations: 9,182 direct original inline equalities, 336 requested-control policy comparisons, 176 standard-profile model comparisons, 32,212 unchanged helper exits and 98 precise refusals. Runtime completes 742 full states, including 120 policy and 20 model successes, with 32 precise refusals. EBF16 is absent; every raw EBF1 dot/matrix observation, including coincident results, remains in the standard-profile model class, while raw EBF1 conversion/MLA and accepted retained enables use the policy class. Supplementary Unicorn cannot execute BF16: 20,464 single cases and 48 joined sequences remain explicitly unavailable with zero equality credit. Current emitted artifacts, feature checks and selected recipe bridges retain separate original, runtime and historical proof identities.

complex_numerical.review: Primary 14,919 full captures separate 14,737 direct-compatible original successes from 182 precise retained-enable refusals. Current native direct inline equality, unchanged helpers and refusals remain distinct from actual Rust completion. No policy/model successes apply. Supplementary Unicorn has extra-IOC defects in Q0 indexed Half: 5,941 matching observations and 418 differences are retained with zero supplementary raw/joined equality credit. Strict runtime/cache checks use primary single-instruction expectations. Final raw checks separate 4,379 direct original inline equalities, 25,095 unchanged helper exits and 364 precise refusals; Rust completes 726 full states with 84 typed refusals and 960 caller-MXCSR checks. Baseline S/D uses packed SSE2 Add and an exact-product-guarded MLA. Independently checked FMA serves S/D MLA, including negative FMA for 180 degrees; Double pair swaps retain PSHUFD. Half uses the compact Double loop with one architectural Half rounding, checked F16C widening and direct indexed-pair broadcast; Half FMA remains excluded. Exceptional or inexact intermediate cases retain the precise core boundary. Selected single-instruction bytes, measured recipe bodies and cached blocks/suffixes require separate final bridges; timings remain bound to their original measured compiler/placement.
